boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on corridors beside or within Loyola’s practical North Baltimore orbit, each with a documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Evergreen Museum & Library
cards.subtitle: North Charles Street corridor
cards.notes: Plan a museum visit or collection-focused research stop at 4545 N. Charles Street; check the museum’s visitor information before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Historic-house museum and research-library stop beside campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Evergreen Museum & Library is at 4545 N. Charles Street and provides visitor and collection-access information.
cards.access_notes: Temporary exhibitions are self-guided; museum access and tickets should be checked in advance.

cards.title: Notre Dame of Maryland University
cards.subtitle: North Charles Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the adjacent university campus as a North Charles Street landmark and consult its visitor materials before entering buildings or attending events.
cards.short_summary: A neighboring university campus immediately north of Loyola.
cards.evidence_claim: Notre Dame of Maryland University is located at 4701 North Charles Street in Baltimore.
cards.access_notes: Campus access and event availability vary; verify with the university before visiting.

cards.title: Loyola Notre Dame Library
cards.subtitle: Winston Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the shared library at 200 Winston Avenue for information resources supporting Loyola and Notre Dame academic programs; confirm visitor policies first.
cards.short_summary: Shared academic library between the two neighboring institutions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Loyola Notre Dame Library is at 200 Winston Avenue and supports Loyola and Notre Dame academic programs.
cards.access_notes: Check library access rules and service availability before arrival.

cards.title: Belvedere Square
cards.subtitle: York Road corridor
cards.notes: Browse the market, retail, and service mix at the York Road and Northern Parkway corner; use the square’s directory for individual vendors.
cards.short_summary: A nearby market-and-retail square with multiple daytime options.
cards.evidence_claim: Belvedere Square is at the southeast corner of York Road and Northern Parkway and includes retail, dining, and services.
cards.access_notes: Retail and vendor hours vary; consult the directory before visiting.

cards.title: Senator Theatre
cards.subtitle: York Road corridor
cards.notes: Check the current program, then catch a film at the restored main auditorium on York Road; the box office opens before the day’s first show.
cards.short_summary: A York Road cinema with a restored 1939 main auditorium.
cards.evidence_claim: The Senator Theatre is at 5904 York Road; its main auditorium was built in 1939 and restored in 2013.
cards.access_notes: Ticketed screenings; consult current showtimes before going.

cards.title: Enoch Pratt Free Library—Roland Park
cards.subtitle: Roland Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Head to the Roland Park branch at 5108 Roland Avenue for a library stop; check the locations page for current branch status and hours.
cards.short_summary: Public-library branch on the nearby Roland Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Enoch Pratt Free Library lists its Roland Park branch at 5108 Roland Avenue.
cards.source_title: Enoch Pratt Free Library Locations & Hours
cards.access_notes: Verify current branch hours and services on the library’s locations page.

cards.title: Sherwood Gardens
cards.subtitle: Greenway corridor
cards.notes: Take a daytime walk through the public garden bounded by East Highfield, Underwood, Stratford, and Greenway; stay on permitted paths and follow garden rules.
cards.short_summary: Free public garden with a documented spring tulip display.
cards.evidence_claim: Sherwood Gardens is open to the public from dawn to dusk year-round, has free admission, and is bounded in part by Greenway.
cards.access_notes: Open dawn to dusk; there are no public restrooms and bicycles are not permitted in the garden.

cards.title: The Ivy Bookshop
cards.subtitle: Falls Road corridor
cards.notes: Browse books or attend an author event at the bookstore on Falls Road, then use its publicly open gardens as described by the shop.
cards.short_summary: Independent bookstore in a former church with public gardens.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ivy Bookshop is at 5928 Falls Road and says its nearly three acres of gardens are open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Check the bookstore’s current hours and event details before visiting.

cards.title: Homewood Museum
cards.subtitle: North Charles Street corridor
cards.notes: Reserve time for a self-guided or docent-led visit at 3400 N. Charles Street to explore the Federal-era house and its documented collection.
cards.short_summary: Federal-era historic house museum on the Charles Street route.
cards.evidence_claim: Homewood Museum is at 3400 N. Charles Street and offers self-guided and docent-led tours of its Federal-era rooms and collections.
cards.access_notes: The historic building is not accessible to visitors using walkers or wheelchairs; check tour availability before going.

cards.title: Baltimore Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: North Charles Street corridor
cards.notes: Reserve a free general-admission ticket for galleries, then allow time for the Sculpture Gardens at 10 Art Museum Drive near North Charles Street.
cards.short_summary: Free general-admission art museum near the North Charles corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baltimore Museum of Art is at 10 Art Museum Drive near North Charles Street, and general admission is free.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Baltimore Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Free general-admission tickets are required; special exhibitions need separate tickets.
